description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Revenue protection Order No. 06/2016 made to require the Director General of Customs to demand and Levy on import duty and substituting List of Concessions and List of Exemptions w.e.f. 11.11.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification contains a legal/regulatory order made by the Minister of Finance under the Revenue Protection Act, No. 19 of 1962. It specifically deals with alterations to import duty rates, deletion of existing concessions and exemptions lists, and substitution of new lists under the Customs Ordinance. The content focuses on regulatory changes to customs duties and tariff structures, which falls squarely under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes.
